title: Unlinked Items
description: Identifies content items that are defined but not referenced anywhere in the project. Also detects dependencies on vanilla Minecraft content that may change.

191.title: Unused Item
191.description: Warning when a defined resource (entity, block, item, etc.) is not referenced by any other content. The item may be unused or the reference may be missing.
191.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the identifier of the unused item

205.title: Vanilla Reference
205.description: Recommendation to avoid direct references to vanilla Minecraft items. Vanilla content may change between game versions, potentially breaking your add-on.
205.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the vanilla item identifier being referenced
